info.description:
## Getting started
Receive user messages and control events, then call the message APIs to reply. Obtain the environment-specific API origin from the IM team; the API prefix is `/api/v1/bot`.

To obtain a Bot token, contact the IM team with `owner_username`, a `username` starting with `bot_`, `nickname`, `avatar_url`, and an optional `webhook_url`. These are onboarding details, not the `/create` request schema.
`/create` requires a signed-in user session via `Authorization: Bearer <user token>`, not a Bot token. See its request schema below.

## Authentication and responses
Token methods accept `X-Api-Key: <bot token>` at `/api/v1/bot/<method>`, or a token in `/api/v1/bot/<bot token>/<method>`. This reference uses the header form. Privileged methods additionally require the configured privileged Bot IDs.
API responses use `{code, message, data}`. Success is HTTP 200 with `code: SUCCESS`; errors use the appropriate HTTP status and `data: null`. Check both status and code. Search results use protobuf JSON; other responses use ordinary JSON.

## Receiving events
Use `bot.getUpdates` to long-poll `data.events`, or configure `webhook_url` to receive POST requests. Webhooks do not consume polling events; deduplicate by Bot and event ID when using both.
Webhook bodies are JSON event arrays, without the API envelope. Events contain `id`, `version` (currently `v1`), `timestamp` in milliseconds, `event_type`, and `data`; webhooks also include `bot_id`.
Event types include `user_message`, `group_message`, `edit_message`, `bot:delete_topic`, `bot:fork_topic`, `bot:skip_thinking`, and `bot:stop_responding`. Delivery depends on the action and visibility rules. Accept unknown event types.
Message and edit events carry `data.message`. Topic deletion carries `data.user` and `data.topic`; topic fork additionally carries `data.messages` as conversation history. Control events identify their target in `data.message`. Optional payload fields may be absent.
Webhook requests have a 10-second timeout. Network failures and HTTP statuses >= 400 are logged without automatic delivery retries. Persist events before acknowledging them; delivery is best effort. Polling also has bounded retention.

Example webhook body:
```json
[{"id":"1768903490706-0","version":"v1","timestamp":1768903490706,"event_type":"user_message","bot_id":6888,"data":{"message":{"message_id":"696f5342fd5c13c38d85103e","message_type":"text","user_id":123,"to_user_id":6888,"text":"Hello","attachment":null}}}]
```
info.title: SIU Bot API

get.description:
Returns `data.events`; an empty array is returned when the long poll times out.
Only events after `start_id` are returned. Omit it to read from the oldest retained event; use the last processed event ID for the next request.
Events through the last returned ID are deleted before the HTTP response is sent. A lost response cannot restore these events. Persist received events and your cursor, and deduplicate repeated IDs.
Polling backlog retention is bounded by the server configuration and may vary by Bot.
Webhooks do not delete polling events. Deduplicate by Bot and event ID when using both.

parameters.description: Exclusive event ID cursor; omitted means 0
parameters.name: start_id

parameters.description: Positive event count; omitted means 30, capped at 100
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Nonnegative long-poll seconds; omitted means 10, capped at 30; 0 disables waiting
parameters.name: timeout

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description:
Sends an ephemeral client event, e.g. an agreed typing indicator. Not stored in the persistent event log or intended for offline replay. Success data is {}.
Requires nonzero user_id and nonempty event_type. Event types are not restricted to an enum; client behavior is agreed with the caller. Data is an unchanged string, optionally empty. A supplied topic_id must belong to this bot and recipient.

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description:
All fields are optional. Omitted or null fields retain their current values. Empty webhook_url or greeting strings clear them; an empty avatar_url leaves the avatar unchanged.
features and profile replace the entire object; omitted nested fields reset to zero values. An empty features object disables all switches and clears input rules. group_message_policy is a top-level field.

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

get.description: Returns the authenticated bot profile, token, group delivery policy, and features stored in the database.

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description: Requires an active user session (`Authorization: Bearer <user token>`). Use the returned bot token for subsequent Bot API calls. The initial group delivery policy is mention_only.

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description:
Accepts JSON file metadata, not multipart bytes. Returns file_id, upload_url and expired_at; the URL expires after five minutes.
PUT raw file bytes to upload_url with the matching Content-Type. If supplied, use the same content_md5 as Content-MD5 and match positive content_length to the uploaded byte count and Content-Length. Then sendPhoto with file_id and nonzero width/height.

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description: Text messages only. Requires message_id, nonempty replacement text (at most 1 MiB of UTF-8 bytes), and exactly one nonzero target identifying the chat. Returns the message ID and updated text.

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description:
Requires message_id and exactly one nonzero target. Clears text, buffered reasoning and attachments; retains the ID and leaves the message as a draft. Subsequent chunks reuse this ID. Revoked messages cannot be emptied.
To regenerate a private-chat reply: empty the old Bot message, resend chunks from index 0 with the same message_id, user_message_id and topic_id, then call finishStreamMessage. Do not omit message_id when regenerating.
Emptying does not reset the user's stop marker. Requests for the same user_message_id may still be rejected during its five-minute lifetime.

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description:
After the last chunk, pass the returned message_id and user_message_id from the user event. Only P2P via to_user_id is supported; to_group_id is ignored.
Omitted or null text/reasoning assembles stored chunks in index order. Empty text overrides to empty; [] clears reasoning. Final text is limited to 1 MiB of UTF-8 bytes. Finished messages reject further chunks.

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

get.description:
Returns readable P2P messages between this Bot and user_id from the last 30 days, newest first. Obtain user_id from an event or the recent-users list.
For the next page, pass the previous page's last message_id as before_message_id. The cursor must belong to this chat; an expired cursor returns an empty page. Encrypted messages are excluded.

parameters.description: P2P peer user ID, required and nonzero
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: Exclusive cursor from this chat; reads older messages
parameters.name: before_message_id

parameters.description: Page size; omitted, invalid or nonpositive means 50, capped at 100
parameters.name: limit

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

get.description:
Returns P2P peers with activity in the last 30 days, ordered by latest message ID, newest first. Peers whose latest message is encrypted are excluded.
For the next page, pass the last latest_message.message_id as before_message_id. An expired cursor returns an empty page. Use user_id with message.listMessages.
The window uses inbox activity time; imported messages may differ from the history endpoint's message-time window.

parameters.description: Exclusive cursor: previous page's last latest_message.message_id
parameters.name: before_message_id

parameters.description: Page size; omitted, invalid or nonpositive means 50, capped at 100
parameters.name: limit

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description: Requires message_id and exactly one nonzero target identifying the chat. Supports text, voice and media-stack messages, subject to message permissions. Success data is {}.

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description:
Restricted to privileged Bots. Searches chat history visible to user_id, including P2P chats and joined groups.
Query is trimmed and must remain nonempty. Optional bot_id filters by conversation participant, independently of the calling Bot.
Returns data.results using protobuf JSON; individual result fields are not expanded in this reference.

parameters.description: User, query and optional participant filter
parameters.name: request

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description:
Supply a nonzero user or group target; user target wins if both are set. Text must be nonempty and at most 1 MiB of UTF-8 bytes. Returns message_id.
For ordinary replies, omit topic_id. To associate a topic, use the user event data.message.topic_id. Streaming uses sendStreamMessage and requires topic_id on every chunk.

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description:
Supply a nonzero target and file_id or image_url. User target wins over group target; file_id wins over image_url.
File mode: obtain a URL from uploadMedia, PUT the bytes, then supply file_id and nonzero width/height. Files must belong to this bot. Currently thumbnail_file_id still resolves to the main file.
URL mode: used only when file_id is empty. thumbnail_url defaults to image_url; thumbnail_file_id is ignored and dimensions need not be nonzero. Text is an optional caption. Returns message_id.

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description:
First chunk: omit message_id and start at index 0. Reuse the returned ID for later chunks and finishStreamMessage.
Every chunk requires user_message_id from the user event data.message.message_id and the same topic_id from data.message.topic_id. Do not substitute a message or session ID for topic_id. Without a topic, use sendMessage without topic_id.
Currently only P2P via to_user_id is supported; group streaming via to_group_id is not supported. User target wins if both are nonzero. Combined UTF-8 bytes of text and reasoning strings must not exceed 32 KiB per chunk; final text is limited to 1 MiB at finish.
Reasoning entries should be single-line JSON objects, e.g. {"type":"title","id":"1","payload":"Thinking"} and {"type":"text","id":"2","payload":"Searching"}. Client convention: matching id appends unless replace=true; parent_id identifies a parent row. The server validates only nonempty, valid JSON entries.

First-chunk example (replace the IDs with those from the user event):
```json
{"to_user_id":123,"topic_id":"696f5600fd5c13c38d851301","user_message_id":"696f5342fd5c13c38d85103e","index":0,"text":"Hello","rich_reasoning":["{\"type\":\"title\",\"id\":\"1\",\"payload\":\"Thinking\"}"]}
```

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description:
Restricted to privileged Bots. Supply user_id or username; nonzero user_id takes precedence. An empty lookup is rejected.
Returns ID, username, nickname and avatar URL. A missing user returns an error.

default.description: API error; inspect code and message

post.description:
Restricted to privileged Bots. Searches contacts belonging to user_id, not the calling Bot.
Query is trimmed and must remain nonempty. Fuzzy matching applies to 2 to 255 Unicode characters; other nonempty lengths still allow exact matching.
Returns data.results using protobuf JSON; individual result fields are not expanded in this reference.
